title: Thailand's Compute Pause
srcNote: Main data: Thailand's Board of Investment, the Energy Policy and Planning Office (EPPO) and EGAT, with company releases and press.
tagline: Big cloud pledges, 35 GW of requests, then a pause on 166 projects and a move to charge data centres more for power.
